<!--
  _partials/_setup.qmd: loaded at the top of every interactive page.

  1. Starts R in the browser (webR) and loads the R package popgen/R/*.R.
     All population genetics happens there. Afterwards a page can call any
     R function:   rows = R.call("simulate", {N: 50, replicates: 20})
  2. Imports the chart functions (js/plots.js), which only draw.

  If you add a new .R file to popgen/R/, add it to the list below.
  Files starting with "_" are not rendered as pages by Quarto.
-->

```{ojs}
//| include: false
import { createR } from "/js/r-bridge.js"
import {
  alleleTrajectoryPlot, genotypePlot, hardyWeinbergCurves, finalFrequencyHistogram,
  heterozygosityPlot, genotypeBars, curvePlot, trajectoryWithBand
} from "/js/plots.js"
import { GENOTYPE_COLORS, SCENARIO_COLORS, COLORS } from "/js/theme.js"

Rstart = createR([
  await FileAttachment("/popgen/R/models.R").text(),
  await FileAttachment("/popgen/R/simulate.R").text(),
  await FileAttachment("/popgen/R/stats.R").text()
])
R = Rstart
```

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
// Shows a short note only while R is starting (or if it failed to start).
Rstatus = {
  yield html`<div class="r-status">R wird im Browser geladen … (beim ersten Besuch einige Sekunden)</div>`;
  try {
    await Rstart;
    yield html``;
  } catch (e) {
    yield html`<div class="r-status r-error">R konnte nicht geladen werden. Bitte Seite neu laden.</div>`;
  }
}
```
